scope: Fresh reader-precision review of the eighteen-chapter, two-appendix SGPT Part I prequel, including the expressly requested Example 6.1.3 foundations and Pang–Sun–Wang–Zhou (2026), exact v1 Theorem 1.2 at arbitrary mass.

validation.visual_scope: Paired unit evidence records direct page inspection and any RGB-identical carry. Final delivery directly displayed front matter, both part introductions, table of contents, conventions, index and bibliography: 34 physical pages. Rendering or text comparison alone is not direct visual inspection.
validation.source_package_payload: Tracked source and evidence files at package creation, including staged new delivery records, except the local operational handoff plan/SESSION_LOG.md. Generated build outputs and the final rebuild log written during validation are excluded. Archive checksums remain outside their own archive.

github.synchronization: Final push and exact-head CI state are checked separately; no self-referential commit SHA is embedded in its own source payload.
